a.xlink:title: Enqueue a high-priority render request for a visible page or slice.
Enqueue a low-priority predictive lookahead request for an upcoming page.
Look up a rendered page handle, returning a closest-zoom placeholder if still rasterizing.
Check whether all visible pages and slices have finished rendering.
Advance and reply to pending IPC command waiting on render or search readiness.
Slot connected to PdfRenderer::render_advance signal for event-driven readiness.
